tasks.short: Observe vital signs and assess physical condition

steps.what: Observe patients' vital signs and assess physical condition in context

tasks.design: Retain bedside observation and assessment with the technician, using existing monitoring equipment in {OTHER}. Test native display configuration if retrieval is separately burdensome; monitor runtime does not remove observation or clinical interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical condition depends on both measurements and the patient's presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing measurement displays support observation without establishing a new labour reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a measurement problem from a meaningful change in condition.
tasks.human_edge: Observing the person and recognising when findings need clinical attention.
tasks.altitude: Observation and escalation responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a change in physical condition
reach.learn: Clear observation reporting and local escalation practice

evidence.claim: The supplied imaging, coding and documentation capabilities do not establish replacement of bedside vital-sign observation or condition assessment.

assumptions: Boundary covers focal observation and assessment; nurse assessment, treatment decisions and separate documentation retain their own time.

OTHER is existing vital-sign measurement equipment. Technician obtains measurements and observes presentation during s1, checking identity and context within that time. No new machine step assumes a ready structured deterioration flag or validated patient-monitor feed.
Existing native monitor configuration is the first option if an observed display problem emerges.
No new application, model or data capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there any separate repeated retrieval work beyond essential bedside observation?

incremental.description: No new upkeep or transferred work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=0, incremental=0, net=0. Existing monitor runtime and clinician work do not create focal labour savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains direct observation and contextual assessment.
reach: Communicate changes clearly to nursing colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A technician who gives nursing colleagues clear, timely observations grounded in the patient's presentation.
